7135.title: ACP quiet-window fragmentation and silent completion attention
7135.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge ends agent turns after five quiet seconds between completed tools, while every successful root active-to-idle transition advances unread attention regardless of output.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff addresses both mechanisms; cooperative agent support and compatibility still require verification.

7135.proposedFix: Negotiate explicit background run boundaries and propagate a typed user-facing attention decision to the server. No duplicate fix PR: open PR #7136 already closes the issue.
7135.caveats: Real bridge and migrated SQLite reproduced twice; no live Hermes, desktop screenshots, or historical 17-turn session verification. Reproduction code is embedded in the report, not published as separate artifacts.
